sources.title: Government Finance Statistics, Statement of Operations (GFS_SOO): revenue series of Honduras, domestic currency, annual
sources.note: The series used, as the IMF’s SDMX interface returns them (XML). The values are in units of domestic currency.

sources.title: IMF Data: GFS Statement of Operations (GFS_SOO), dataset page
sources.note: The dataset page: description, metadata and download.

sources.title: Codelist CL_GFS_INDICATOR (names of the classification lines of GFS_SOO)
sources.note: Gives the name of each line (for example G1111_T, taxes on income, profits and capital gains payable by individuals), which follow the Government Finance Statistics Manual 2014.
